title: Dual‑guided LP ascent + SA warm start (26 circles, 10‑min)
abstract: Warm start with size‑aware SA (5 min), then refine centers via LP dual‑guided trust‑region ascent using HiGHS marginals. Final LP tighten returns the best packing.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/noesis')
from pack.lp_sa_core import run_sa_then_dual, lp_radii_for_centers

def construct_packing():
    # 5 min SA warm start + 5 min dual ascent refine
    centers, radii, obj = run_sa_then_dual(budget_s_sa=300.0, budget_s_dual=300.0, pair_exp=1.5)
    # Final LP tighten
    r_final, obj_final, ok = lp_radii_for_centers(centers)
    if ok:
        radii = r_final
    return centers, radii
